title: helianthemum canum f. molle
intro: Helianthemum canum f. molle, commonly known as rockrose, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing, reducing inflammation, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
